result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The one visually broken element is the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, which shows a persistent loading spinner overlaid on an already-rendered image, indicating a stuck or leftover loading state. Other elements (carousels, promo banner, nav bar) render as expected.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image even though the image itself has fully rendered. This indicates a stuck/orphaned loading indicator that was never dismissed, making the card look broken and partially obscuring the image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loading placeholder/spinner is removed once the image load completes (hook into onLoad/onError), and add a timeout fallback so the spinner never persists indefinitely over loaded content.
